audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[4..6] read Zoe / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, matching the packet levelChart — three rows rendering two answers.
audit.why: Level 6 belongs to Zoe: Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces the target's Magic Resist and doubles the first damage that breaks the sleep, and Portal Jump is a 5-11s blink she can weave mid-combo. From the first item Rod of Ages health lets Aurelion Sol survive a bubble, and from two items his permanent Stardust passes a burst kit that needs an isolated target.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side -> Zoe, phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol, proposed as one atomic group with phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to argue for their new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Starsurge' and 'Comet' were used for Aurelion Sol abilities, 'Sleepless bubble' for Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and his ultimate was called 'global' three times.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's Q is Breath of Light and his R is Falling Star at 1250 range — not global. Zoe's E is Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
audit.corrected: All replaced with real names, and the ultimate's actual range used where the claim mattered.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive property of Sleepy Trouble Bubble was never stated anywhere: the sleep reduces Magic Resist and the first damage that breaks it is doubled.
audit.why: Riot's E text gives both. That is why this matchup is not a poke war — it is one landed bubble converting into a full kill, and why armour or MR stacking is not the answer.
audit.corrected: Written into enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.carry, dontsFull[2].d, whys[2], spikes[0].text, phases[4].why and content early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Portal Jump was described four times as roaming mobility and mid-combo repositioning that 'outpaces your response tools'.
audit.why: Riot's text is 'Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back' at 575 range on 11/8/5. It is a short there-and-back blink, not a roaming or escape tool, and it is the reason she genuinely cannot run once she oversteps.
audit.corrected: Each mention now carries the real range and cooldown, and wants.foe[2] re-pointed at what actually makes her roams work.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zoe is female, but the full layer called her 'he/his/him' in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, three phases[].why, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].t, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t and report[11].t — and dontsFull[0].d called her 'they'.
audit.why: champ-gender lists zoe as female. The owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun in these fields refers to Zoe.
audit.corrected: All corrected. his -> her and him -> her are the same length, so every one of these fits the band exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles; dontsFull[0].d, ahead, breakdown.carry and breakdown.feeding were name-swap templates.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed and the template sweep.
audit.corrected: All six rewritten from Zoe's kit at the same length.

audit.why: Real numbers: Sleepy Trouble Bubble 18/17/16/15/14 at 800 range, Paddle Star 8.5 down to 6.5, Portal Jump 11/8/5 at 575.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around those three, with the 'never start Q while her bubble is up' sequencing line made explicit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Zoe is female and the full layer misgendered her in fourteen writable fields plus a 'they' in dontsFull[0].d — every one is corrected here, and because his -> her and him -> her are the same length, all of those land inside the band unchanged otherwise. TWO supplied missing-interactions were NOT written because they come from misfired derived flags. (1) 'Your Astral Flight shuts off Zoe's Portal Jump' rests on a terrain flag on Aurelion Sol's W, but Riot's text says he 'flies over terrain' — he traverses it, he does not create it, so it walls off nothing. (2) 'Zoe can cut your retreat with Sleepy Trouble Bubble' rests on a terrain flag on her E, and Riot's E text describes drowsiness, sleep, reduced Magic Resist and doubled wake-up damage — no terrain at all. The other two supplied interactions (channel cancel, and resistances being the wrong answer via the MR shred) ARE grounded in Riot's text and are written in. Portal Jump was described four times as roaming mobility and a clean escape; it is a 575-range blink out and back on 11/8/5. Fabricated names removed: 'Starsurge', 'Comet', 'Sleepless bubble', and a 'global' ultimate that is 1250 range. Chart rows 4/5/6 proposed as one atomic group with their whys.
